description: ComingUp Today helps families organize shared household schedules, lists, notes, contacts, and recipes. Connect your ComingUp Today account to view your household information in ChatGPT and make supported changes to ComingUp Today content. Access is limited to the household information your account is authorized to use. Events from connected external calendars are read-only, and household administration and cross-household access are not available through this integration.

defaultPrompt: How do I connect ComingUp Today to ChatGPT?
